value.rationale: Stationary snapshots cannot distinguish pause distributions having the same mean, but the long-time integrated-position variance strictly identifies their second moment at every 0<a<1. A sharp universal deterministic minimizer and full attainable half-line solve the motivated temporal identifiability and clock-design questions; neither follows from spatial stationary distributions alone.
